# sendgrid_google_analytics_settings (Resource)

Manages the account-wide Google Analytics tracking setting, which appends UTM parameters to links in emails. This is a singleton: SendGrid has exactly one Google Analytics configuration per account (or per subuser, via the provider's `on_behalf_of`); creating this resource updates that configuration in place, and destroying it only removes it from Terraform state without resetting SendGrid's setting.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sendgrid_google_analytics_settings" "this" {
  enabled      = true
  utm_source   = "sendgrid.com"
  utm_medium   = "email"
  utm_campaign = "spring-sale"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Google Analytics tracking is enabled.

### Optional

- `utm_campaign` (String) The name of the campaign.
- `utm_content` (String) Used to differentiate ads.
- `utm_medium` (String) The marketing medium, e.g. "email".
- `utm_source` (String) The referrer source.
- `utm_term` (String) Paid keywords.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `google_analytics_settings`.
